University guidance identifies Annandale, Newtown, Chippendale and Glebe for shared off-campus housing.
Accommodation-provider guidance also identifies Camperdown, Darlington, Newtown, Redfern and Glebe; not a measured student-residence distribution.

limitations: Public advertisement snapshots do not confirm current availability, whole-property/per-person billing scope, bills or lease terms.
No numerical claim about where most international students reside is established by the area guides.
Reference photos are from the exact same unit/address and labelled with the actual source page.
A dash in advertised parking is retained as zero advertised spaces, not a guarantee about parking availability.
One added listing had no matching public-transport alternative in the returned reference-time sample; its three road-mode estimates remain available.
